original.title: Monaco Yacht Show 2026: day-two news and the questions behind the launches
original.excerpt: A September 24 briefing on Monaco Yacht Show 2026: Blue Wake award winners, the latest press agenda and what yacht owners should check next.
original.introduction: Monaco Yacht Show 2026 is underway at Port Hercule from September 23 to 26. This September 24 briefing follows the organizer’s opening-day Blue Wake awards announcement and the current press agenda. The useful questions for an owner concern the evidence behind a new system, what a builder has actually announced and whether a design fits the way you use a boat. Reporting here is based on published sources; Gray Yachts is not reporting from the docks.

sections.heading: Opening-day news: the Blue Wake awards
paragraphs: The organizer’s September 23 release confirms that six Blue Wake awards were presented on the show’s opening day. It names Tykun, Bespoke Projects, Termodinamica, Amico & Co and Marina Ibiza as category winners, with a special yacht prize for Simena by Ares Yachts. The programme works with Water Revolution Foundation to assess the submitted environmental evidence.

The winning subjects reach beyond propulsion. They include tender construction, interior materials, air conditioning, refit facilities and seagrass restoration. That range gives owners several different lines of inquiry. Before applying an award announcement to your own boat, ask which product or project was assessed and whether the operating conditions resemble yours.

sections.heading: September 24: announcements to follow up
paragraphs: The show’s press agenda lists an Oyster flagship announcement, a Camper & Nicholsons design project and the GX42 world premiere for September 24. It also lists a Romeo Marine presentation covering the completed Romeo 55 and a preview of the Romeo 60 under construction. Those are scheduled presentations; a timetable alone does not establish what was ultimately revealed.

For a buyer, the next useful document is the builder’s dated release or specification sheet. Ask whether the announcement concerns a delivered boat, an available hull, a concept or a future production model. Keep that distinction in your comparison notes, especially if your next purchase depends on a delivery date.

sections.heading: How to read an environmental claim
paragraphs: When reading an environmental claim, it is useful to begin by identifying the exact claim. Does the evidence cover manufacturing, operation or the vessel’s full life cycle? Ask what the comparison boat or system was, which assumptions were used and whether the assessment is available to read. Different boundaries can make two impressive figures unsuitable for direct comparison.

Then bring the question back to your own use. A boat that spends long periods at anchor presents a different set of questions from one used for frequent passages. Ask the builder to explain the equipment in that context, including support and service arrangements. A qualified surveyor or marine specialist can help assess whether the proposed system suits the vessel and your plans.

sections.heading: Use the remaining show days for specific questions
paragraphs: The 2026 event is scheduled to finish on September 26. If you are following remotely, save the announcement you are interested in and note its date. If you are attending, confirm appointments and access directly with the exhibitor before planning around a particular yacht.

A short written brief helps keep the conversation focused. Describe how you intend to use the boat, where you expect to keep it and what you need to understand before a second conversation. Ask for a follow-up document that answers those points. A rendering or launch photograph can introduce a design; plans and verified specifications make it possible to compare alternatives.

sections.heading: What this means for a Pacific Northwest owner
paragraphs: Monaco can introduce ideas for a future purchase, but deciding how to sell your current boat still starts with its condition and relevant market comparisons. Keep active asking prices separate from verified completed sales. A show announcement does not establish a resale value or guarantee a faster sale.

If you are considering a change, bring the particular model or system that caught your attention to Connor Gray. Gray Yachts can discuss your current boat and a Pacific Northwest sale plan while you investigate the replacement. Organizing the service records and documenting current equipment gives that conversation a useful starting point.

questions.question: When is Monaco Yacht Show 2026?
questions.answer: The organizer lists September 23 to 26 at Port Hercule, Monaco. Confirm the current visitor information and any yacht appointment directly before making plans.

questions.question: Are the September 24 launches confirmed in this briefing?
questions.answer: They are identified as items on the official press agenda. This briefing does not treat a scheduled presentation as proof of the final announcement or independently verified yacht performance.

questions.question: Were these photographs taken at the 2026 show?
questions.answer: No. The Monaco harbor lead image is illustrative and has no verified event year. The show photographs are labeled 2022 archives. Other section photographs are clearly identified stock or Gray Yachts brokerage imagery.
